items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: I saw a television show with Bud Freeman, Pee Wee Russell, and Bob Hackett playing bass.

ctx.x: I mean he never got to be a professional quality, but it was just like that. It was fantastic. Who was your friend that was a drummer?

That boy later turned out, I think he's kind of an unprofessional beatnik right now. He is very talented. He painted very well. And I understand he's writing very well, but he kind of lost interest in music completely because modern jazz confused him, although he liked it very much. I think he came to the same realization that I did, that you had to play music, the music that was expressive of your time, if it was to be improvisation anyway. What's his name? His name was Charles Meriwether. Actually I was always…
What about Bix? You never got on a Bix kick ever?
